parent_objective: run public geometry-aware preflight-only smoke before bounded replay
blocked_by: M1434 implemented preflight-only command but source viability has not been measured
supersedes: running bounded replay before geometry-aware preflight smoke

public_gates: M1435 must run --preflight-only on public M1425 rows
M1435 must report forward geometry rows selected rows clipping share and source diversity
M1435 must not run bounded replay train PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs
M1435 must route to audit if geometry/source gates fail
forbidden_shortcuts: do not export a training corpus
do not lower geometry gates after seeing the result
do not count preflight rows as actual replay or history-positive evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs preflight-only source geometry validation on public M1425 rows before any bounded replay
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public source preflight smoke only; no replay run, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
fallback_plan: route to preflight result audit if source gates fail
route to bounded replay design if source gates pass
route to source mining if M1425 rows remain geometry-poor

admission_evidence: M1433 requires source geometry validation before replay
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up audit or replay-design manifest
next_stage_criteria: source geometry and diversity gates pass or fail clearly

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1435 only checks source geometry and cannot claim history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: preflight verifies source rows before future history replay
preflight rows cannot count as actual history-positive replay evidence
future replay still needs reset and zero-current controls
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1425 public pressure rows filtered through M1434 preflight-only command.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If preflight gates fail, record source limitation and audit instead of weakening replay or history standards.
allowed_claims: no replay result, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1425 pressure rows contain enough forward unclipped source-diverse geometry to justify a later bounded relocation replay design.
failure_criteria: preflight rows are counted as replay evidence
run starts replay training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input changes

commands.name: preflight_smoke
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.bounded_relocation_replay_probe --preflight-only --checkpoint runs/m1362_bidirectional_active_set_interpolation_preflight/checkpoints/alpha_0_1.pt --config configs/m1419_warmup_gate_invasiveness_retune_source_wave.json --candidate-rows runs/m1425_action_divergent_outcome_pressure_source_smoke/outcome_pressure_rows.csv --max-candidate-rows 128 --per-capability-pair-cap 12 --per-seed-cap 24 --per-reveal-bucket-cap 12 --per-variant-cap 48 --history-length 56 --min-sequence-action-l2 0.025 --min-source-body-x 4.0 --device cpu --run-dir runs/m1435_geometry_aware_preflight_smoke

decision_rule: M1435 passes only if preflight-only source geometry and diversity gates pass without replay or training.
